PR Summary by Qodo

Support CI-gated pull requests for changes to main ✨ Enhancement 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation ⚙️ Configuration changes 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add a configurable pull-request workflow for kit applies while retaining direct mode.
>• Wait for required CI checks and stop unsuccessful applies before ordinary playbook rules.
>• Adapt mission reviews, diagnostics, and operator guidance for protected main branches.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Config["Repository setting"] --> Kit["Kit apply"] --> Mode{"Main mode"} --> PR["Kit pull request"] --> Checks["Required checks"] --> Merge["Merge to main"] Mode --> Direct["Direct apply"] Checks --> Stop["Stop on failure"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Orchestrate kit pull requests in handsd
- ➕ Make branch, check, and merge transitions mechanically enforceable. - ➕ Reduce reliance on a builder following a long prompt. - ➖ Require authenticated GitHub writes and substantial daemon state management. - ➖ Increase migration and recovery complexity beyond this mission's scope.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the incremental prompt-based approach: it preserves direct mode and limits hands' new GitHub access to reads. Follow up with a real end-to-end apply and review under an enabled ruleset; the report explicitly says those paths are not yet proven.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
